title: Cash reporting and verification demand the full total after a deposit
triage: CONFIRMED by reading CashService/OrderService; fixed in this branch
evidence: OrderService.placeOnce inserts cash_obligation.amount_minor as q.totalMinor() - q.depositMinor(). CashService.java:96-106 instead calculates discrepancy against customer_order.total_minor; lines 127-150 use that total again for verification. apps/operations-web/src/cook/Orders.tsx:182 initializes the report amount from order.total.

title: Staff grants become usable without MFA
triage: Realm flow as code + StaffMfaIdpTest (real Keycloak) + optional require-staff-mfa; live preview/staging realm NOT changed or verified (no Docker/SSH for the agent). See docs/security/staff-mfa-enforcement.md
evidence: AccountMapper.java:49-50 unconditionally adds active permission authorities; assurance claims are merely copied at lines 56-62. SecurityConfiguration's API chains require ACCOUNT_ACTIVE without a staff MFA guard. StaffCaseController.java:31 requires only PERM_support.case. CashController.java:70 requires only PERM_finance.verify. StaffAssurance is invoked only by selected endpoint annotations.

title: Reusable upload URL can replace an approved private document
triage: CONFIRMED by code reading; approved documents now sealed to documents/<id> and upload key deleted after commit
evidence: S3ObjectStorage.java:48-50 signs PUT without checksum or overwrite protection. MediaService.java:121 issues the upload URL; lines 132-133 skip verification for approved media; lines 273-274 generate approved document read URLs using row.privateKey().

title: Cash reporting and verification charge the full total after a deposit
triage: duplicate of CR-001
evidence: CashService.java:77-78 selects o.total_minor; :96-106 computes discrepancy and obligation state; :127-150 again uses o.total_minor for verification. OrderService.java:203-208 correctly creates cash_obligation with total minus deposit. apps/operations-web/src/cook/Orders.tsx:182 initializes the form from order.total. docs/product/09-deposit-payment-states.md states cash due at handover is the remainder. Static rg found no deposit/DEPOSIT/remainder references in backend/app/src/test/java/com/matbakhy/app/finance.

title: Permanent request recovery accepts a changed payload when its quote is unchanged
triage: V29 request_fingerprint on customer_order; OrderService compares it on recovery; legacy rows (null) keep quote-only check. Tests: a_reused_request_reference_with_a_changed_field_conflicts_even_after_the_cache_is_gone, orders_placed_before_the_fingerprint_migration_keep_quote_only_recovery
evidence: OrderService.java:139-146 selects only id and quote_id and returns before policy or note checks. JdbcIdempotentCommands.java:54-59 creates a new request hash when no cache record remains. OrderPlacementIntegrationTest.java:268-271 tests retention with an identical body; :284-299 tests changed quote IDs, not changed fields on the same quote. docs/product/03-business-rules.md:68 specifies payload conflict.

title: Deposit expiry coverage does not exercise transfer/receipt races
triage: a_transfer_report_racing_expiry_is_reconciled_or_refused_never_lost (6 rounds, invariant based)
evidence: DepositPaymentIntegrationTest.java:205-223 races two transfer reports; :245-256 reports before advancing the clock and expiring. OrderLifecycleIntegrationTest.java:428 names the acceptance/cancellation/expiry race. docs/delivery/07-owner-decisions-implementation-sequence.md:20 requires expiry and capacity claims to be race-safe.

title: Receipt authorization test uses a non-cook instead of a foreign kitchen owner
triage: another_approved_kitchen_cannot_receipt_report_a_problem_or_refund_a_foreign_deposit
evidence: DepositPaymentIntegrationTest.java:231 calls receipt with UUID.randomUUID().toString(). PaymentService.java:81-83 rejects actors lacking a kitchen before :267-270 checks order ownership. PaymentReconciliationIntegrationTest.java:176-179 correctly creates a second approved kitchen for the problem endpoint, demonstrating the stronger fixture pattern.

title: Revocation test reauthenticates instead of reusing the existing authentication
triage: IdentityIntegrationTest.reused_token_loses_staff_access_once_the_grant_is_revoked reuses one real Keycloak token across revocation through the real security chain; the reviewed test file was not the only coverage. Residual: revocation via the admin API on the same token is not combined (Low).
evidence: StaffAccessIntegrationTest.java:97-99 defines as() as logins.login(...). The revocation test invokes as(staffSubject) at :162 and again at :167. docs/product/06-permissions.md:26 explicitly requires current grants to be checked for sensitive commands.

title: Price-race tests replace the production price-update command with handwritten SQL
triage: the_real_cook_price_edit_refuses_a_stale_quote_and_never_touches_a_committed_order (production PATCH path). True interleaving of the production update with placement is still covered only by the SQL stand-in lock-order tests: residual Medium risk, recorded.
evidence: PriceChangeIntegrationTest.java:118-120 and :150 call the helper; :204-215 explicitly describe and implement a SQL imitation of MealService.update. The existing real browser price-change journey supplies useful sequential integration, but not this concurrent production-command boundary.
